tools.name: list_matches
tools.description: Matches on one calendar day with their status: upcoming, pending (reading shown, not yet locked) or finished.

tools.name: get_match_analysis
tools.description: Home / draw / away probabilities from each available model, the most likely outcome, the confidence, the pre-match favourite, when the reading was locked, and the result with a hit flag once the match has finished.

tools.name: get_match_context
tools.description: Head-to-head summary, recent form, injuries and suspensions, and schedule density, limited to what is shown publicly on the site.

tools.name: get_open_record
tools.description: Hits out of matches for the public record, the pre-match favourite and random baselines on the same matches, results by confidence band, and snapshot coverage. Without week_start it covers the whole record; with it, that week only.
